content:
Before its official release on Friday, we've put together a list of iPhone 18 Pro accessories that I'll be picking up myself this year. Speaking for myself, the Apple AirTag 2 and the next-generation AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are absolutely the best accessories to pair with the iPhone 18 Pro—not to mention the world's top-tier polishing cloth—but this time we want to go a bit deeper: chargers, MagSafe stands, cases, wallets, and more. Check out the introductions below.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance — Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max
  • Ben — Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael — Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin — Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  • Ryan — iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Car Mount
  • Fernando — Burgundy Picogo Air Ultra Slim Charger
  • Simon — Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Adapter
  • Justin — Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand
  • Reinette — Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Clear Case
  • Other Personal Picks

If you want to charge your new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max as quickly as possible, you need a compatible charging brick. Specifically, you need a charger that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply, and Apple's offering is currently the best one on the market. It features a compact, foldable design and can charge the iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max to 50% within 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven case combines an attractive appearance with an excellent feel, paired with anodized aluminum buttons that offer a unique tactile experience, and comes in a range of deep, rich colourways—all made from 100% recycled polyester fibre, staying true to its environmental commitment.

Anker's compact three-in-one wireless charger can power three devices simultaneously through a single portable accessory, and delivers Qi2 wireless charging compatible with MagSafe for your iPhone. It folds down to an extremely small size, fitting easily into a travel bag, letting you cut down on the number of cables and adapters you need to bring along—or you can neatly arrange your entire Apple device lineup on a nightstand or desk. And today it's also discounted by nearly 35%, hitting an all-time low on Amazon.

Apple's FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe has always been a must-buy iPhone accessory for those pursuing a minimalist style. It can easily hold 3 to 4 cards, whether it's an ID card, a few credit cards, or an access card—perfect for anyone who doesn't want to lug around a bulky wallet every day.

Every time I get in the car, I want a stable, secure place to put my iPhone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top pick. You can magnetically attach your iPhone 18 Pro or an older model to the mount, and the mount conveniently clips onto the vehicle's air vent. The MagSafe mount keeps your iPhone secure while keeping the screen clearly visible, and can also continuously charge your phone while you drive—three benefits in one.

I've always believed that the MagSafe battery pack you use daily with your iPhone should be as thin as possible. Baseus has just released what I consider the perfect MagSafe battery. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs just 3.7 ounces. It has a built-in 5,000mAh battery, with wireless charging up to 7.5W and wired charging up to 22.5W. The best part is that the manufacturer has released a colourway that perfectly complements the all-new burgundy iPhone. That's how MagSafe batteries should be designed—slim and light above all.

If you travel frequently, you already know that organising your tech bag is half the battle. That's why I always keep an eye out for versatile charging gear. Baseus's travel adapter fits the bill perfectly, supporting outlets in over 200 countries and capable of powering six devices simultaneously. However, what attracts me most is the built-in retractable 70W USB-C cable, which can not only charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed, but also deliver stable charging performance for iPads, MacBooks, and more.

I'd recommend the one Michael picked above—I personally think it's the best foldable MagSafe charger for travel on the market right now—but for my own use, I prefer my two favourite desktop three-in-one models: the extremely stylish and minimalist 25W Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand, in a gorgeous space black finish; and Anker's Smart Display 3-in-1 model, which I also quite like, but the Satechi is simply too elegant, with a refined, understated beauty that's truly incomparable.

After spending so much on an iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually go for more affordable accessories rather than chasing the most premium products, and Spigen has plenty of reasonably priced MagSafe cases. My top pick is the Ultra Hybrid MagFit Clear Case, which is far cheaper than comparable products, or its solid-colour multi-colour version—both are MagSafe models that support fast wireless charging. Both also feature a DuraClear TPU side panel infused with blue resin to prevent yellowing, plus shock-absorbing design, and notably, the camera control button is also covered with a TPU thin layer for protection.

  • AirTag 2
  • Anker 100W USB-C Smart Display Charger
  • Beats Woven USB-C Cable
  • All-New Pitaka Burgundy MagSafe Aramid Fibre iPhone 18 Pro Case
  • Nomad iPhone 18 Pro Leather Case
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case
  • Twelve South Butterfly 2-in-1
  • Nomad Find My Tracking Card
